title: analytics: the /analytics/sql dry run renders one bucket for a selection the query refuses (two granularities of one column, a column raw beside its bucket)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kE5BrPUPNMMyv6oCH

Blocked-by: PR #28837

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #28799 dev (PR #28837, os-dev-report `6565320589`), raised as a should-fix by the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review `6565544468`. It was read in the tree and has not been measured on the wire. Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim.

Reach: `ObjectQLStrategy.generateSql`, the `/analytics/sql` dry run, builds its GROUP BY from its own one-granularity-per-dimension map (`granByDim.set` in `packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/objectql-strategy.ts`). After PR #28837, `execute()` refuses two granularities of one column with `INVALID_QUERY` / 400 through the engine's duplicate-column door. The echo runs no engine, so it still renders one `year` bucket for that pair. The same drift already exists on `main` for #28765's shape, a column raw beside its own bucket. The file's own rule that the echo and the query "accept/reject the SAME set" has these exceptions. `/analytics/query` is not affected, because it awaits the engine before it calls `generateSql`.

## Wanted

`/analytics/sql` answers the same refusal as the query for every selection the query refuses because one column is asked twice, with the same code, status and fields. Alternatively, it renders the statement from the same key builder (`aggregateGroupKeys`) and refuses through the shared door.

1. Measure both shapes on the echo first.
2. Reuse the #28765 preview door (`preview-group-column-door.ts`) or the module-level builder rather than a third copy. ⛔ No new gate.
3. ⛔ No new root export or public member on `ObjectQLStrategy`.

This narrows the echo: a dry run that answers today is refused. So it is `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, with a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review owed.

## Dedupe

Read open issues for `analytics/sql`, `generateSql granByDim` and `dry run refuses`: #28798 (the refusal's alias remedy wording, same door) and #28799 (PR #28837). **New.**

Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/services/service-analytics`).

Links back: #28799, PR #28837, #28765, PR #28794, #28798
